tested_commit_semantics: Base commit plus working-tree changes identified by current artifact SHA-256; not a claim that new tests exist at the base commit.
decision_resolution: SC-DEC-045 software scope implemented within existing compute: interrupt-safe planning reuses complete matching frames and schedules interrupted or stale frames; no external spend or rendering.
positive_checks: Matching completed frame reused; partial/mismatched frames pending; resume advances only completed records.
negative_checks: Absent low-priority lease, zero frames, invalid scene and requested qualification upgrade rejected.
limitations: Software verification with synthetic controls only; no physical qualification.
Planner assumes caller-verified frame bytes and atomic completed-record publication; no Blender rendering or human layout review executed.
next_dependency: Independent integrator review; scientific admission still requires qualified source evidence.
